item.title: The Era of Cloud Work
item.description: Author: Wang Jianguo / Wu Bin Publication year: 2016-11-1 ISBN: 9787508668024 Notes: The book’s main point is that in the internet era, working from home and collaborating remotely is a better fit. From there it goes on to discuss how business owners and workers can harness this way of working, and the author offers some of his own thoughts.
